name: Intelliprint API Reference
description:
Send mail as easily as sending email. With the Intelliprint API, you can send letters and postcards in just a few lines of code.

The API is designed to be [REST-ful](https://w.wiki/4YH8). Every resource has a predictable URL, and every endpoint accepts data encoded as [JSON](https://w.wiki/Qi$) or [multipart/form-data](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7578). Responses are JSON-encoded with standard HTTP status codes.

Authentication requires an API key ([create one here](https://account.intelliprint.net/api_keys)) in the `Authorization` header.

Questions or feedback? We're here to help at [hello@intelliprint.net](mailto:hello@intelliprint.net).
